source_rows.quote: 4,C0049,"Convergence of random-cluster interfaces to SLE(kappa) for q in (0,4], q not 2",attempted_un,FK interfaces to SLE for q not 2
source_rows.scope: Dated ranking title and attempted status; it does not establish the exact theorem statement or current openness.

exact_statement: Duminil-Copin 2017 Conjecture 3: for fixed q <= 4 at p=pc, Dobrushin domains approaching a simply connected marked domain, the exploration path converges weakly to SLE(kappa), kappa=4pi/(pi-arccos(sqrt(q)/2)); the C0049 title selects 0<q<=4 and excludes q=2.
exact_statement_source: https://arxiv.org/pdf/1707.00520 PDF p.92 (Conjecture 3); web lines 8413-8429; q=0 appears as endpoint limit, whereas the C0049 title says q>0.
current_openness: UNKNOWN_MATHEMATICALLY; a primary 2026-10-05 preprint expressly claims C0049 for 1<=q<=4, and a companion expressly claims 0<q<1. Presence and theorem scope verified; proof not independently checked.

new_primary_preprint.title: Conformal Limits of Critical Square-Lattice Random-Cluster Interfaces
new_primary_preprint.scope_checked: For each fixed 1<=q<=4, bounded marked Jordan D and approximations satisfying its equation (1.3), it asserts Dobrushin strand convergence in its topology (1.4) to chordal SLE(kappa(q)); not uniform in q.
